decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already captures the independently relevant requirement that high-speed mixing remain smooth and not overly aggressive; splash-control details remain owned by REQ_SPLASH_CONTROL.
Possible use of a splash guard or adjustment of bowl depth does not change the required bowl-removal and swapping behavior, and no mitigation option is definitively selected.
Whisk positioning is mentioned only as a conditional splash-mitigation option; the client does not change the selected whisk style, material, size, or attachment.
Bowl-depth adjustment is only a possible mitigation if needed and does not establish a new bowl capacity or form.
The source decision concerns splash and smoothness during high-speed mixing, not valve operation, dispensing flow, or the mix-to-pour sequence.
Controlling splashing at higher mixing speeds does not alter the existing plumbing-seal or leak-containment requirements.
The splash-control decision does not modify the CAD deliverable or selected overall design direction; the listed mitigation options are not finalized layout changes.
The high-speed splash-control decision has no effect on the beige and green color scheme.
The source splash-control MODIFY does not select a specific guard, whisk position, or bowl-depth change for the BOM, and the candidate's deliverable obligation remains valid unchanged.
The splash-control decision does not affect machine wording, display name, or placard placement.
The requirement to control splashing at higher speeds does not change the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The source addresses mixing-bowl splash behavior rather than spout geometry, orientation, construction, or beverage-quality preservation during dispensing.
